purpose: Teach: 三宮/松平/トゥ/吉井/岩本/半田/栗山/入江

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、神戸三宮の医療機関と医療チームで連携します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be coordinating with the medical facilities and teams in Kobe Sannomiya.
lines.style: Professional, measured opening. Clear articulation of each institutional name. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone delivering important information without drama.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、徳川松平家ゆかりの古医書を医療チームで保管します
lines.en: Ren, we'll keep the historical medical texts from the Tokugawa and Matsudaira families on file with the medical team.
lines.style: Same professional register. Slight precision on the historical names — respectful weight. No hurry. The clarity of someone who has explained complex lineages before.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、英語医療文献のトゥ、つまり「to」表記を医療チームで正確に訳します
lines.en: Ren, the medical team will ensure we translate English medical literature accurately — particularly the notation 'to' — into precise Japanese equivalents.
lines.style: Deliberate pause before the clarification in dashes. Technical precision without condescension. Speaking to an intelligent listener who needs exactness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者吉井様のご症状を医療チームで継続観察します
lines.en: Ren, we'll continue to monitor Mr. Yoshii's condition with the full medical team.
lines.style: Formal address of the patient by name and title. Steady delivery. The tone that signals continuity — this is ongoing, not concluded.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者岩本様のリハビリを医療チームで支援します
lines.en: Ren, the medical team will be supporting Mr. Iwamoto's rehabilitation.
lines.style: Same measured pace. Clear weight on the patient's name. Professional confidence — this is a team commitment, not a question.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療機器の半田、つまり半田付け修理を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Ren, we'll manage the maintenance of medical equipment — soldering repairs and all — through the medical team.
lines.style: The clarification on 'soldering' in dashes feels practical, almost understated. Technical but not jargon-heavy. Steady competence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者栗山様のご症状を医療チームで継続観察します
lines.en: Ren, we'll continue monitoring Mr. Kuriyama's condition as a team.
lines.style: Same register as before. Formal name address. The rhythm of someone running through a list with equal care for each item.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、海岸の入江、つまり入江での溺水救助を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, the medical team will handle any drowning rescue response that might occur in the coastal inlets.
lines.style: Slight shift here — this one carries different weight. Steady, but with an undertone of preparedness. Not alarmed, but alert. Slight fade on the final phrase.
